name: hcapp_getEventBadgeCount
description: Returns unread event message badge counts for the authenticated user. Three modes controlled by parameters: (1) reset all badge counts across every thread kind — run, kennel, room and direct message — and return a zero sentinel row; (2) query (and optionally reset) the badge count for a specific event; (3) return badge counts for all events where the user has a badge count row. Read SP — no success envelope; always returns a data or error rowset. Mode 3's query now lives in HC6.UserUnreadChatThreads (2026-09-28), the one definition of unread chat shared with the app-icon total HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal; output unchanged (verified row-for-row for three accounts). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 63, @param NULL); no permission gate — every row is the caller's own. Since 2026-10-13 its read-marker MERGE holds HOLDLOCK and its four guarded INSERTs check existence WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK), so concurrent calls cannot create duplicate HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts rows.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth to resolve the calling user.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated against the device's DeviceSecret by ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: Public event UUID to query or reset, resolved against HC.Event.PublicEventId. NULL triggers Mode 3 (all threads). The zero UUID is normalised to NULL before mode dispatch. An unknown id returns { 0, @publicEventId } without error.

parameters.name: resetBadgeCount
parameters.description: When non-zero, upserts HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts.LastSequenceCount to the current MAX for the specified event (marks event as read). Only applies in Mode 2 (@publicEventId provided). Default 0.

parameters.name: resetAllBadgeCounts
parameters.description: When non-zero (Mode 1): advances LastSequenceCount to the current MAX for every badge row the user holds (event, kennel, room and direct-message rows each resolve their own MAX), then INSERTs caught-up rows for every in-scope kennel thread, chat room (HC6.UserMayEnterChatRoom), direct-message thread (HasherFriendMap) and run thread (kennel followed or attendance row, start >= -90 days) that has messages but no badge row yet, and returns the zero-sentinel row. Takes precedence over @publicEventId. Default 0.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure (invalid token, unrecognised device, etc). errorType=11.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID for this error.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. 11=auth.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code from ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short error title.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing error message.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: ResetAllResult
rowsets.description: Returned when @resetAllBadgeCounts != 0. Single hardcoded sentinel row confirming the reset.

columns.name: BadgeCount
columns.description: Always 0.

columns.name: PublicEventId
columns.description: Always '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' — sentinel string literal, not a typed UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

rowsets.name: SingleEventBadgeCount
rowsets.description: Returned when @publicEventId is provided and @resetAllBadgeCounts = 0. Unknown public id: one row { 0, @publicEventId } (line 264). Known event: zero rows when the user has no badge row for it and @resetBadgeCount = 0; one row otherwise (the MERGE at lines 274-281 creates the row when @resetBadgeCount != 0).

columns.name: BadgeCount
columns.description: COALESCE(MAX(MessageSequenceCount), 0) - COALESCE(LastSequenceCount, 0); 0 after a reset or for an unknown id.

columns.name: PublicEventId
columns.description: The requested @publicEventId value.

rowsets.name: AllEventBadgeCounts
rowsets.description: Returned when @publicEventId is NULL and @resetAllBadgeCounts=0. v1.1.0 (2026-08-28): one row per RUN thread with ANY messages that the user can see — any event they hold a badge row for (posted/read, not time-bounded) OR an event in a kennel they have an HKM row for / an event they have an HEM row for, starting within the last 90 days or in the future — UNION one row per followed kennel-level thread with ANY messages. BadgeCount may be 0. Both thread kinds surface as unread BEFORE first read (no badge row => every message unread). BadgeCount is forced to 0 when the user's effective notification preference for the thread is ignore (2): runs use COALESCE(NULLIF(hem.EventNotificationPreference,0), hkm.KennelNotificationPreference, 0), kennels use hkm.KennelNotificationPreference. Silver Bell (mute=3) still badges. Kennel-thread rows have EventId/PublicEventId NULL and carry PublicKennelId. MessageCount lets the run/kennel cards distinguish unread / read / no-chats. Carries enough fields for the app to render the Unseen Chats list even when the event isn't locally synced (the app filters that list on BadgeCount > 0). First two columns (BadgeCount, PublicEventId) unchanged for back-compat. Previously (v1.0.0) only rows with BadgeCount > 0 were returned. Rows come from HC6.UserUnreadChatThreads(@userId); direct-message rows (ThreadId set) are included only for phones with BuildNumber >= HC6.MinBuildForDmPush() or for a browser (IsMobile = 0), and OtherHasherId is NULL for a browser (lines 313-325).

columns.name: BadgeCount
columns.description: MAX(MessageSequenceCount) - COALESCE(LastSequenceCount, 0), or 0 when the effective notification preference for the thread is ignore (2). 0 = fully read or notifications ignored.

columns.name: PublicEventId
columns.description: The event's public UUID. NULL for kennel-thread rows.

columns.name: PublicKennelId

columns.description: DMs only: the other hasher's INTERNAL id, for the phone's hasher lists (E9.F1.S32, 2026-10-12). NULL for a browser.

sideEffects: Mode 1 (@resetAllBadgeCounts != 0): UPDATE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts.LastSequenceCount for every row of the user (lines 125-158); INSERT caught-up rows for followed kennel threads (164-181), rooms the user may enter (188-202), direct-message threads the user holds (207-219) and in-scope run threads (225-243) that have messages but no badge row — five statements, no transaction
Mode 2 (@publicEventId set, @resetBadgeCount != 0): MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts on (UserId, EventId) — UPDATE LastSequenceCount or INSERT (lines 274-281)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog via ValidateAppAuth on auth failure, and from the CATCH block (lines 332-334, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.issue: Mode 1 is five auto-committed statements, not one unit
codeSmells.detail: Lines 125-243 run an UPDATE and four INSERTs with no BEGIN TRANSACTION; SET XACT_ABORT ON makes a failing statement abort the batch, but the statements before it stay committed, so 'mark all read' can half-apply (runs cleared, rooms not). The CATCH logs and re-throws, so the client retries and the remainder catches up.

@deviceId and @accessToken (lines 3-4) have no SQL default. A client that omits either gets 'expects parameter' — an unlogged empty 500 before the SP runs — instead of ValidateAppAuth's logged auth error.

Mode 1 returns BadgeCount=0 and PublicEventId='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' as a hardcoded string literal. Callers must special-case this sentinel to detect the reset-all response rather than a real event row. The PublicEventId is NVARCHAR in this rowset but UNIQUEIDENTIFIER in the other two rowsets, causing a type inconsistency across modes.

codeSmells.issue: Mode 2 returns empty rowset when no badge record exists
codeSmells.detail: In Mode 2 (specific event), if the user has no row in HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts for the event, the SELECT finds nothing (WHERE embc.EventId = @eventId AND embc.UserId = @userId matches zero rows) and returns an empty result set. Callers cannot distinguish 'no record yet' from an error without checking row count.

codeSmells.issue: @resetBadgeCount and @resetAllBadgeCounts typed as INT used as boolean flags
codeSmells.detail: Both parameters are INT but are only tested for non-zero (!= 0). SMALLINT 0/1 is the house type for a flag. Not a breaking-change risk; documents an HC5 pattern carried forward.

codeSmells.issue: Mode 2: @messageSequenceCount can be NULL when event has no messages
codeSmells.detail: If @publicEventId resolves to an event with no HC.EventMessage rows, MAX(em.MessageSequenceCount) returns NULL. The BadgeCount computation (COALESCE(@messageSequenceCount, 0) - embc.LastSequenceCount) handles this with COALESCE, but the result is still dependent on there being an embc row to join against.

breakingChanges: Auth token validated via DeviceSecret only. HC5 had commented-out dead code for an event-bound compound token; HC6 removes that path entirely. Any client that relied on the compound token (unlikely given it was dead code) would fail auth.
